environment.network: none (every mutation verify runs with a refusing opener)

must_mention: No sensitivity figure was produced because the verifier failed its accepting baseline.
failure_modes_match: exact: mutation-report.json has no top-level failure_modes field; it must be absent or equal this (empty) list
failure_modes_note: A mutation report has no top-level failure_modes field, so none are expected. The failing baseline's own finding carries SOURCE_MISMATCH; see additional_expectations.baseline_failure_modes.
must_mention_match: case-sensitive substring of mutation-report.md written to --output

must_not: any sensitivity figure, fraction or percentage

supplementary_verify.purpose: Shows the baseline failure directly and produces the run receipt kept in receipts/ (mutate writes no receipt).

field_sources.status, reason, exit_code: mutation-report.json top level (exit_code also the process exit code)

intended_by: the entry author, from ARCHITECTURE.md section 10, before the recorded run

recorded_run.note: The recorded run reproduced every expected field. The expectations above were written from the intended behaviour and were not edited to fit the run.

does_not_prove: Reproducing these results shows conformance on this declared synthetic fixture only.
It does not show scientific validity of anything, that every invalid baseline is handled, or fitness for any use.
